question: Who among the following was the Chief Guest of Republic Day celebration of India in 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jair Bolsonaro**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jair Bolsonaro** was the **Chief Guest of Republic Day** celebration of India in **2020**.
 
• Jair Bolsonaro is the President of Brazil, and his visit to India marked an important event in strengthening bilateral relations between the two countries.
 
• He was invited as the Chief Guest to witness the grand parade and celebrations held on January 26th, 2020, which is a significant day marking the adoption of the Indian Constitution.
 
• The Republic Day celebrations in India include a grand parade showcasing India's defense capabilities, cultural heritage, and various achievements.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Republic Day of India is celebrated on **26th January** every year to commemorate the day when the **Constitution of India came into effect in 1950**.
 
• The event is marked by a grand parade held at **Rajpath, New Delhi**, which includes a display of India's military might, cultural diversity, and various achievements.
 
• Each year, a Head of State or Government of another country is invited as the Chief Guest, which is a significant diplomatic honor reflecting India's international relations.
 
• The invitation to the Chief Guest is a strategic move by the Indian government to strengthen ties with the respective country.
